name: Secrets of Sorcery
source:
You're moving to Dusuka city to attend Dusuka Academy, the most prestigious higher learning academy in the whole country. You're pretty excited, but you've never seen your adoptive mother looking as nervous as she did on the drive over...Something is wrong...Little do you know that soon revelations will shake your entire world to its core, and you'll find your very life at risk. Navigating this new normal, you'll meet 12 beautiful and complex characters. Getting to know them and growing closer throughout the game. Some of these new friendships may even blossom into more intimate relationships. Every character has a story for you to find your place in.

[From [url=https://habardgames.itch.io/secrets-of-sorcery]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将搬到杜苏卡市就读杜苏卡学院，这是全国最负盛名的高等教育学院。你非常兴奋，但你从来没有见过你的养母像在开车过来时那样紧张……出事了……你几乎不知道，很快的真相就会彻底震撼你的整个世界，你会发现你的生命处于危险之中。在这个新常态中，你将遇到12个美丽而复杂的角色。在整个游戏过程中了解他们并变得更加亲密。其中一些新的友谊甚至可能发展成为更亲密的关系。每个角色都有一个故事供你找到自己的位置。

[来自[url=https://habardgames.itch.io/secrets-of-sorcery]itch.io[/url]]
